title: 冻结BERT中AI文本检测神经元的机制研究：稀疏探测与激活修补
summary: 研究冻结BERT-base编码器中支持AI文本检测的神经元，使用RAID基准和L1-to-L2稀疏探测协议，发现不到1%的稳定神经元即可保留大部分检测精度，激活修补证实其因果相关性，并揭示指令微调生成器在末层集中30-36%稳定神经元的二分结构。
summary_en: This study investigates which neurons in a frozen BERT-base encoder support AI-text detection using the RAID benchmark. Applying L1-to-L2 sparse probing to all 9,216 CLS hidden-state dimensions recovers a stable set of under 1% of neurons per generator that retains most detection accuracy. Bidirectional activation patching confirms causal relevance, and cross-generator analysis reveals a bipartite structure where instruction-tuned generators concentrate 30-36% of stable neurons in the final layer.
